body.x: A physical album is a thing a fan can hold and collect, but it usually needs a player or an account to come alive. One that makes its own power from a press, and can be handed to a friend but not copied, bridges the keepsake and the stream.
Muzlive Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Mobile Devices, Accessories & Apps and Content & Entertainment at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for KiT Zero, a battery-free physical album.

KiT Zero is the battery-free KiT inside the KiTalbum, a pocket-sized collectible album format for smart devices. Each KiTalbum pairs collectibles such as art cards and photocards with music, video and images in the KiTplayer app.

When a fan presses the KiT, the motion makes its own electricity, turning a gear train and coreless generator to power one transmission: the KiT emits a short, inaudible ultrasonic signal that a phone or tablet microphone recognizes, and KiTplayer opens and downloads the album in lossless audio, video and images. Because the album is tied to the KiT rather than an account, it can be handed to another person but not copied, where earlier KiT used a CR2032 coin cell.
More than 10 million KiTalbums have shipped since 2017, and sales count toward national album charts in Korea, the United Kingdom, Germany and Australia, and in the United States from 2 October 2026.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
